patch_description: This replaces the Kalman-state approach with a causal multiscale robust local-regression filter. At every newest window endpoint, it estimates both a fast local quadratic trend and a slower robust linear trend. Their adaptive blend provides low-lag tracking during curvature, turns, and rapid motion while the slow estimate suppresses noise during stable periods. A persistence-and-distance reversal controller exposes a new direction only after coherent evidence, preventing one-sample noise reversals without delaying strong genuine turns. The implementation remains causal, preserves the original public functions and output alignment, and uses only small sliding-window regressions.
